annotations.text:
Add a pet — CRU-096 (issue #131)

Creation stays at three steps. Reminders live on the pet screen; health belongs to the Care Card.

What changed from the shipped flow:
· the stepper names its phases (#132)
· pet type is an inline segmented control, and breed sits under it (#133)
· approximate age is two wheels, and the derived birthday reads back (#134)
· the two-door screen becomes a real choice (#135)
· the photo moves below the name; "Skip for now" becomes "Add without instructions"

Tokens are lifted from src/constants/theme.ts, not from .design/tokens.css — the two disagree on three values and the shipped file wins.
The list is a placeholder set. #116 owns the seeded breeds table, the curation pass and the migration.
A picker fires no blur, so the wheels must call trigger('birthdate') after a change — see KNOWLEDGE.md.
